title: Total protein

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

sources.title: MedlinePlus: Total Protein and Albumin/Globulin (A/G) Ratio

measures: Total protein is the amount of protein in the blood. It is made up mainly of albumin, made by the liver, and globulins, made by the liver and the immune system.
context: Total protein is usually read together with albumin, globulin and the A/G ratio. Some medicines can affect results.
aboveRange: Some immune system or blood conditions
belowRange: Not getting enough nutrition, or problems absorbing it
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
